notes: The largest release Tarang has had. Everything here is new since 1.8.7.8 - 1.8.8.0 was withdrawn within the hour and reached almost nobody, so its changes ship here as one release. Tarang now runs on Android 10 and up, rather than Android 11 and up. Pravah - the YouTube side of Tarang, now a place of its own. New: the YouTube surface is called Pravah, pairing with Tarang, and it is a part of the app rather than a tab bolted onto one. New: captions actually play - Tarang had been fetching them and throwing them away, and they now work with the picture off, which the built-in player's captions cannot do. New: clickbait titles get replaced with plain ones via DeArrow, everywhere including the notification and lock screen, and Tarang asks in a way that never tells the server which video you are watching. New: the dislike count is back, from Return YouTube Dislike. New: Tarang remembers what you watched, with how far into each video you got, and Pravah opens on that instead of an empty search box - nothing leaves the device, and you can remove one entry, turn the whole thing off, or clear it. New: follow a channel and reach it in one tap, a local account-free list with no YouTube account involved. New: read the comments, fetched only when you ask. New: video descriptions open in their own pane, one paragraph at a time, and timestamps in them become real jump buttons - for most videos that is the only way to reach a section. New: video quality is a resolution ceiling now, 360p through 2160p, rather than a choice between the most expensive stream and the cheapest. New: ask YouTube for a particular country's results, which matters if you are outside India searching for Indian content. Radio and playback. New: add a station Tarang doesn't know about by pasting a stream URL. New: resume the last station on launch. New: playback comes back when your headphones do, wired, USB, Bluetooth and LE Audio alike. New: a warning before Tarang spends your mobile data, off by default. New: a Quick Settings tile, home-screen shortcuts for your top favourites, and Copy stream URL. New: stream and YouTube links from other apps open in Tarang. New: a recently-played row, shuffle for favourites, an optional grid layout, a default playback volume, a minimum-bitrate filter, and a data-saver mode. New: the sleep timer can fade out, or stop at the end of a podcast or track. New: skip silence, volume normalisation, quieter ducking for notifications, and a video-quality cap on mobile data. New: a pure-black theme for OLED screens, and EQ presets. Faster, and lighter on your phone. Tarang opens quicker. The station list scrolls and filters faster - changing a filter used to re-scan every one of three thousand stations, and favouriting one re-ran the whole pass. Playing something no longer redraws screens you are not looking at. Video details are fetched once per video instead of on every metadata tick. Steadier. Fixed: Tarang keeps playing when you swipe it out of recents, and recording is no longer cut off mid-file. Fixed: a background problem can no longer take your audio down with it. Fixed: TV channels your phone cannot decode now play as audio instead of failing outright. New: on a bad connection the station list says how old it is and tapping it retries, rather than quietly showing you three-day-old results. Fixed: less memory used on long sessions. Fixed: one bad search result no longer empties the whole page - a single unreadable item used to take the other nineteen with it. Fixed: several crashes on ordinary taps, from lists YouTube can legitimately repeat. Fixed: downloading no longer crashes when the system download manager is off, there is nowhere to write, or the link went stale. Fixed: recording works on the HLS streams most relays actually use - it had been writing the playlist file instead of the audio. Fixed: an update is verified before it installs, and a hostile podcast feed can no longer make Tarang read files it should not. Getting around, with or without a screen reader. New: swipe a station right to favourite it, swipe the mini player to change station, and pull down to refresh - and every one of those gestures steps aside when TalkBack is on, with everything they do still reachable from the actions menu. A swipe is never the only way to reach something in Tarang. Fixed: language filters that could never match anything are gone - thirteen radio chips and four TV chips matched no stations at all, including real languages like Kokborok and Santali, and picking one emptied the list and kept it empty across restarts; when a filter does hide everything, Tarang now names it and offers to clear it. Fixed: cancel the sleep timer without a screen reader - the control had ended up on an invisible, zero-size element, unreachable by TalkBack and gone entirely for everyone else. Fixed: "Shuffle favourites" read out twice, and the visible words weren't the tappable part. Fixed: the recently-played chip announced "Play Vividh Bharati, double tap to Play." Fixed: the Download button announced its own name twice and wore a Share icon. Fixed: the mini player no longer jumps in height when you switch tabs. Also fixed: tapping the notification opens the Tarang you left rather than a second copy. Album art is back on the lock screen for music on your device. A live stream that falls behind catches up instead of dying silently. Station rows are the size of station rows again. Sound enhancement was being applied to the whole phone's audio, not to Tarang's own playback. Resume-on-reconnect never actually fired for Bluetooth headphones. The mobile-data warning could swallow a play command from the notification, lock screen, a headset button or Android Auto. A brief notification no longer pauses you. Calls, alarms and navigation can interrupt the radio again - Tarang had stopped yielding audio focus to anything. Turning Reverb or Sound Stage off while something was playing could stop the audio dead. music.youtube.com links now open as videos instead of being filed away as a station that could never play. Station list settings take effect straight away. Double-tapping the heart can no longer leave a station half-favourited. If you were one of the few who installed 1.8.8.0, this fixes the crash on launch that build had, along with the audio focus, sound-effect and settings problems that came with it. Nothing was lost - your favourites, recently-played and saved positions are all still there.
